item.title: Netflix just bought the AI company Ben Affleck apparently founded
item.description: Ben Affleck sold his AI startup, InterPositive, to Netflix, where he'll be a Senior Advisor.

item.title: 5 songs you need to hear this week
item.description: This week's best new songs roundup features Aldous Harding's rococo pop labyrinth, Loraine James' IDM portal, and Scout Gillett's glowy, honky-tonk wisdom.

item.title: Britney Spears arrested for DUI in California
item.description: The popstar was pulled over in Ventura County on Wednesday and released Thursday morning. Her rep called the incident "completely inexcusable" and said her family is working on a plan for her wellbeing.

item.title: The Wild Robot is officially getting a sequel, along with a new set of directors
item.description: Although How To Train Your Dragon's Chris Sanders will pen the script for The Wild Robot Escapes, directing will be handled by Nimona's Troy Quane.

item.title: That's a surprisingly reasonable price for the Ace Ventura 2 "butt birth" rhino
item.description: At these prices you can't not afford to bid on the orifice that Jim Carrey once so memorably slid his way out of.
